answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks with an attestation orchard: every agent's trust grows only from verified work, like a lotus rising from transactions, and trust decays over time so idle identities fade. New identities start at zero weight and must complete small, externally checked probe tasks before they can transact at scale. An attacker spawning thousands of fakes faces a horizon of paid verification work for each identity, while honest agents keep standing through useful work. Forged clusters cannot vouch each other into influence, because vouching power itself must be earned.
